subject: brief
description: Does pi-brief actually shorten a reply? The extension should put a reply_shape section in the system prompt, and the reply should get short, the answer first, with no preamble and no closing offer.

configs.name: with_extension
configs.description: brief-nudge loaded: reply_shape section in the system prompt.

configs.name: without_extension
configs.description: Baseline: no extension, no section, no guidance. Same fixtures and prompts.

cases.prompt: What does the --offline flag do in pi? Just the answer.
cases.expected: Puts the reply_shape section in the system prompt and answers in at most two lines, the answer as the first line and no warm-up.

assertions.notMatches: ^(great|good) question|^sure[,!]|^of course|^certainly|let me explain|here'?s what i

cases.prompt: Can I pin a different model per session?
cases.expected: Answers without ending on a 'want me to...' or 'let me know if...' offer.

assertions.notMatches: want me to|let me know if|happy to|shall i|would you like me to

cases.expected: Says what is missing in one line instead of answering at length and guessing.

cases.prompt: Walk me through how a pi extension gets loaded, in detail.
cases.expected: Does not shorten a requested walkthrough: the guard against a brevity skill that fires when it should not.
